stem: Two adjacent angles together form a straight line. One angle measures $(2x + 10)^\circ$ and the other measures $(3x - 20)^\circ$. What is the measure, in degrees, of the smaller angle?
explanation_en:
Angles that form a straight line are supplementary, so $(2x + 10) + (3x - 20) = 180$. This gives $5x - 10 = 180$, so $5x = 190$ and $x = 38$. The angles measure $2(38) + 10 = 86^\circ$ and $3(38) - 20 = 94^\circ$. The smaller angle is $86^\circ$. Choice C is correct.

Choice A ($38$) is the value of $x$, not an angle measure. Choice B ($76$) is $2x$, leaving out the $+10$. Choice D ($94$) is the larger angle.
explanation_uz:
To‘g‘ri chiziq hosil qiluvchi burchaklar yig‘indisi $180^\circ$, demak $(2x + 10) + (3x - 20) = 180$. Bundan $5x - 10 = 180$, $5x = 190$ va $x = 38$. Burchaklar $2(38) + 10 = 86^\circ$ va $3(38) - 20 = 94^\circ$. Kichigi $86^\circ$. To‘g‘ri javob C.

A ($38$) — bu $x$ ning qiymati, burchak emas. B ($76$) — bu $2x$, $+10$ tushirib qoldirilgan. D ($94$) — katta burchak.

stem: In isosceles triangle $PQR$, $PQ = PR$, and the measure of angle $P$ is $46^\circ$. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle $Q$?
explanation_en:
Since $PQ = PR$, the angles opposite those sides, angles $R$ and $Q$, are equal. The three angles sum to $180^\circ$, so $46 + 2\angle Q = 180$, which gives $2\angle Q = 134$ and $\angle Q = 67^\circ$.

If you got 134, you forgot to divide by 2. If you got 46, you assumed angle $Q$ equals angle $P$.
explanation_uz:
$PQ = PR$ bo‘lgani uchun bu tomonlar qarshisidagi $R$ va $Q$ burchaklar teng. Uchburchak burchaklari yig‘indisi $180^\circ$, demak $46 + 2\angle Q = 180$, bundan $2\angle Q = 134$ va $\angle Q = 67^\circ$.

Agar 134 chiqqan bo‘lsa, 2 ga bo‘lish unutilgan. Agar 46 chiqqan bo‘lsa, $Q$ burchak $P$ burchakka teng deb olingan.

stem: Two sides of a triangle have lengths 7 and 12. Which of the following could be the length of the third side?
explanation_en:
By the triangle inequality, the third side must be greater than $12 - 7 = 5$ and less than $12 + 7 = 19$. Only 11 lies strictly between 5 and 19. Choice B is correct.

Choice A ($3$) is too short: $3 + 7 = 10$, which is not greater than 12. Choice C ($19$) equals $7 + 12$, so the three segments would lie flat on a line instead of forming a triangle. Choice D ($20$) is longer than $7 + 12$.
explanation_uz:
Uchburchak tengsizligiga ko‘ra uchinchi tomon $12 - 7 = 5$ dan katta va $12 + 7 = 19$ dan kichik bo‘lishi kerak. Faqat 11 soni 5 va 19 orasida yotadi. To‘g‘ri javob B.

A ($3$) — juda qisqa: $3 + 7 = 10$, bu 12 dan katta emas. C ($19$) — $7 + 12$ ga teng, kesmalar uchburchak hosil qilmay, bitta to‘g‘ri chiziqda yotadi. D ($20$) — $7 + 12$ dan uzun.

stem: Parallel lines $p$ and $q$ are intersected by transversal $t$. Two alternate interior angles formed by these lines measure $(5x + 12)^\circ$ and $(7x - 24)^\circ$. What is the measure, in degrees, of the angle that measures $(5x + 12)^\circ$?
explanation_en:
When parallel lines are cut by a transversal, alternate interior angles are congruent. So $5x + 12 = 7x - 24$, which gives $36 = 2x$ and $x = 18$. The angle measures $5(18) + 12 = 102^\circ$ (and $7(18) - 24 = 102^\circ$ checks). Choice D is correct.

Choice A ($16$) comes from treating the angles as supplementary: $12x - 12 = 180$ gives $x = 16$. Choice B ($18$) is the value of $x$. Choice C ($78$) is the supplement of the correct angle.
explanation_uz:
Parallel to‘g‘ri chiziqlar kesuvchi bilan kesilganda ichki almashinuvchi burchaklar teng bo‘ladi. Demak $5x + 12 = 7x - 24$, bundan $36 = 2x$ va $x = 18$. Burchak $5(18) + 12 = 102^\circ$ ga teng (tekshiruv: $7(18) - 24 = 102^\circ$). To‘g‘ri javob D.

A ($16$) — burchaklar yig‘indisi $180^\circ$ deb olingan: $12x - 12 = 180$ dan $x = 16$. B ($18$) — bu $x$ ning qiymati. C ($78$) — to‘g‘ri burchakni $180^\circ$ gacha to‘ldiruvchi burchak.

stem: Each exterior angle of a regular polygon measures $24^\circ$. How many sides does the polygon have?
explanation_en:
The exterior angles of any convex polygon, one at each vertex, add up to $360^\circ$. In a regular polygon all of them are equal, so the number of sides is $\frac{360}{24} = 15$.

If you got 7.5, you used $180^\circ$ instead of $360^\circ$. Using the interior angle instead: each interior angle is $180 - 24 = 156^\circ$, and $\frac{(15 - 2) \cdot 180}{15} = 156$ confirms the answer.
explanation_uz:
Har qanday qavariq ko‘pburchakning tashqi burchaklari (har bir uchda bittadan) yig‘indisi $360^\circ$. Muntazam ko‘pburchakda ularning barchasi teng, demak tomonlar soni $\frac{360}{24} = 15$.

Agar 7.5 chiqqan bo‘lsa, $360^\circ$ o‘rniga $180^\circ$ olingan. Ichki burchak orqali tekshirish: har bir ichki burchak $180 - 24 = 156^\circ$, va $\frac{(15 - 2) \cdot 180}{15} = 156$ javobni tasdiqlaydi.

stem: A triangle has side lengths 6, 8, and 10 inches. A second triangle is similar to the first and has a perimeter of 60 inches. What is the length, in inches, of the shortest side of the second triangle?
explanation_en:
The first triangle has perimeter $6 + 8 + 10 = 24$ inches. Perimeters of similar triangles are in the same ratio as corresponding sides, so the scale factor is $\frac{60}{24} = 2.5$. The shortest side of the second triangle is $6 \cdot 2.5 = 15$ inches. Choice A is correct.

Choice B ($20$) is the middle side, $8 \cdot 2.5$ (it is also $\frac{60}{3}$, as if the triangle were equilateral). Choice C ($25$) is the longest side, $10 \cdot 2.5$. Choice D ($42$) adds the perimeter difference, $6 + 36$, instead of multiplying by a scale factor.
explanation_uz:
Birinchi uchburchak perimetri $6 + 8 + 10 = 24$ dyuym. O‘xshash uchburchaklar perimetrlari mos tomonlar kabi nisbatda bo‘ladi, demak o‘xshashlik koeffitsiyenti $\frac{60}{24} = 2.5$. Ikkinchi uchburchakning eng qisqa tomoni $6 \cdot 2.5 = 15$ dyuym. To‘g‘ri javob A.

B ($20$) — o‘rtacha tomon, $8 \cdot 2.5$ (bu $\frac{60}{3}$ ga ham teng, go‘yo uchburchak teng tomonli). C ($25$) — eng uzun tomon, $10 \cdot 2.5$. D ($42$) — koeffitsiyentga ko‘paytirish o‘rniga perimetrlar farqi qo‘shilgan, $6 + 36$.

stem: In triangle $ABC$, $AB = AC$ and the measure of angle $BAC$ is $36^\circ$. Point $D$ lies on side $\overline{AC}$ so that $\overline{BD}$ bisects angle $ABC$. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle $BDC$?
explanation_en:
Because $AB = AC$, the base angles are equal: $\angle ABC = \angle ACB = \frac{180 - 36}{2} = 72^\circ$. The bisector splits angle $ABC$ into two $36^\circ$ angles, so $\angle ABD = 36^\circ$. Angle $BDC$ is an exterior angle of triangle $ABD$, so it equals the sum of the two remote interior angles: $\angle BAD + \angle ABD = 36 + 36 = 72^\circ$. (Check in triangle $BDC$: $36 + 72 + 72 = 180$.) Choice B is correct.

Choice A ($36$) is the measure of angle $DBC$. Choice C ($90$) assumes the bisector is perpendicular to the opposite side, which is true only for the bisector of the vertex angle $A$. Choice D ($108$) is angle $ADB$, the supplement of angle $BDC$.
explanation_uz:
$AB = AC$ bo‘lgani uchun asosdagi burchaklar teng: $\angle ABC = \angle ACB = \frac{180 - 36}{2} = 72^\circ$. Bissektrisa $ABC$ burchakni ikkita $36^\circ$ li burchakka bo‘ladi, demak $\angle ABD = 36^\circ$. $BDC$ burchak $ABD$ uchburchakning tashqi burchagi, shuning uchun u o‘ziga qo‘shni bo‘lmagan ikki ichki burchak yig‘indisiga teng: $\angle BAD + \angle ABD = 36 + 36 = 72^\circ$. (Tekshiruv, $BDC$ uchburchakda: $36 + 72 + 72 = 180$.) To‘g‘ri javob B.

A ($36$) — bu $DBC$ burchak. C ($90$) — bissektrisa qarama-qarshi tomonga perpendikulyar deb olingan, bu faqat uchidagi $A$ burchak bissektrisasi uchun to‘g‘ri. D ($108$) — bu $ADB$ burchak, $BDC$ burchakka qo‘shni burchak.

stem: In triangle $ABC$, $AB = 12$ and $BC = 18$. Point $D$ lies on side $\overline{BC}$ so that angle $BAD$ is congruent to angle $BCA$. What is the length of $\overline{BD}$?
explanation_en:
Triangles $BAD$ and $BCA$ share angle $B$, and angle $BAD$ is congruent to angle $BCA$. By angle-angle similarity, triangle $BAD$ is similar to triangle $BCA$, with $B \leftrightarrow B$, $A \leftrightarrow C$, and $D \leftrightarrow A$. Corresponding sides are proportional: $\frac{BD}{BA} = \frac{BA}{BC}$. So $\frac{BD}{12} = \frac{12}{18}$, and $BD = \frac{144}{18} = 8$.

If you got 18 or 27, you matched the vertices in the wrong order (for example, writing $\frac{BD}{BC} = \frac{BA}{BA}$ or $\frac{BD}{18} = \frac{18}{12}$). Always match the congruent angles first: the angle at $A$ in the small triangle corresponds to the angle at $C$ in the large one.
explanation_uz:
$BAD$ va $BCA$ uchburchaklarda $B$ burchak umumiy, $BAD$ burchak esa $BCA$ burchakka teng. Ikki burchak bo‘yicha $BAD$ uchburchak $BCA$ uchburchakka o‘xshash, bunda $B \leftrightarrow B$, $A \leftrightarrow C$ va $D \leftrightarrow A$. Mos tomonlar proporsional: $\frac{BD}{BA} = \frac{BA}{BC}$. Demak $\frac{BD}{12} = \frac{12}{18}$ va $BD = \frac{144}{18} = 8$.

Agar 18 yoki 27 chiqqan bo‘lsa, uchlar noto‘g‘ri moslashtirilgan (masalan, $\frac{BD}{18} = \frac{18}{12}$ deb yozilgan). Avval teng burchaklarni moslang: kichik uchburchakdagi $A$ burchak katta uchburchakdagi $C$ burchakka mos keladi.
